conventions.input: the whole sketch before the grab: points, lines (id -> [start, end]), constraints (backend wire form, provisional flags included), shapes (id -> the backend's shape record plus kind), the grabbed point, pinned (the origin; locked points would be here too)
conventions.grab: whether the pre-grab rule lets the point be grabbed (spec 13.5); no frames when false
conventions.frame: start = input.points with every earlier frame's expected.result laid over it; target = where the hand puts the grabbed point (the cursor delta from the grab added to the point's position at the grab)
conventions.expected: proposal: every shape point the proposal sets (spec 13.2/13.3; null when it makes none); provisional: the sizes switched on (hybrid frames only, spec 13.4); hybrid: whether the frame is clamped by the projector; clamp: none | accepted | rejected; result: the positions written back for the proposal's points and any point that moved
